games.name: Arrows of Caelvanor
games.blurb: Hold the watchtower against the Ashen Horde and raise it into the White City.

games.name: Undergrowth
games.blurb: Tap the mushrooms, release the spores and grow the forest floor.

games.name: Survivors of Caelvanor
games.blurb: Hold the beacon road until dawn on the Night of Ash. Evolve your weapons, light the beacons, and run with Garrow the werewolf.

games.name: Beacons of Caelvanor
games.blurb: Ride east with Captain Ithren, raise towers and light the nine beacons. The prequel to Arrows of Caelvanor.

games.name: Thunder Keep
games.blurb: Hold the dirt road against the Red Host with archers, longbows, swordsmen and monks.

games.name: Runes of Caelvanor
games.blurb: Match runes as Wren the Hearthfolk wizard and follow the beacon road east to break the Cinder Heart.

games.name: Runes of Caelvanor II
games.blurb: Follow the last embers north with the Grey Pilgrim. Crack frost, snuff hollow embers, gather moonpetals and defuse cinder bombs on the road to the Wildwood.

games.name: Seeds of Caelvanor
games.blurb: Mind the Bramblefold garden as Sam Tumbleroot, grow and sell crops, and pack crates for Wren on the road east.

games.name: Cauldron of Caelvanor
games.blurb: Apprenticed to the Grey Pilgrim, Wren drops and merges ingredients in an old iron cauldron to brew remedies along the beacon road.

games.name: Hearths of Caelvanor
games.blurb: Found Greenhold where the black glass turned green. Build farms, forges and walls, raise your Town Hall and fend off Ashen raiders.

games.name: The Too-Big Sword
games.blurb: Walk east with Pip and his far-too-big sword. Pick skills, beat bosses, and help bring Ithren home.

games.name: Whispers of Caelvanor
games.blurb: A hundred years on, a stubborn young man keeps an old witch's fire burning, earns her magic, and uncovers who she really is.

games.name: Moonbound
games.blurb: A Caelvanor romance. A bookish young wizard, a grumpy old werewolf, one hut and one bed. Choices, puzzles and more than one ending.

games.name: Hatchlings of Caelvanor
games.blurb: Build a floating dragon isle, merge eggs into rarer ones, and send your hatchlings out to gather. Play realm minigames for more eggs.
